text.en:
The authorized capital of the National Development Company, created under Commonwealth
Act No. 182, as amended, is hereby further increased to Four Hundred Fifty Million Pesos (P450,000,000.00),
the additional capitalization to be fully subscribed by the National Government: Provided, however, That two
Hundred Ten Million Pesos (P210,000,000.00) of the additional capitalization shall be used as equity
participation in the copper smelter project of the Philippine Associated Smelting and Refining Corporation

To pay for the additional capital subscription mentioned in the preceding section, the sum of
Two Hundred Fifty Million Pesos (P250,000,000.00) is hereby appropriated out of the available funds in the
National Treasury, Fifty Million Pesos (P50,000,000.00) of which shall be released in Calendar Year 1977 for
the equity contribution to the copper smelter project and subsequent releases for such project shall be made
from time to time in accordance with a schedule of equity payments as recommended by the Presidential
Advisory Committee on the Copper Industry and approved by the President of the Philippines.

Under the provision of the Presidential Advisory Committee on the Copper Industry, the
National Development Company shall, as stockholder in the copper smelter project, exercise all the rights,
privileges, powers and duties as such: Provided, however, that all dividends and moneys representing returns
on investments in such project shall be remitted by the National Development Company to the National

Any law, decree, order, rule or regulation inconsistent herewith is hereby repealed or amended
accordingly.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 11th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
